text: 金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤新德里宣言（摘要）：肯定金砖国家工业渠道7个专门工作组的工作，肯定智能制造和机器人工作组在智能工厂发展、解决方案共享、标准合作和人才培养等方面所做努力。 认识到人工智能为促进经济增长和实现可持续发展提供了巨大机遇。指出利用人工智能促进经济增长和社会福祉，对于推动各国特别是全球南方国家实现公正、公平、平等和繁荣的未来至关重要。肯定上海世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议，认可其在加强人工智能国际合作、智能向善方面的贡献。（新华社）
text_en: New Delhi Declaration of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting (Summary): Affirmed the work of the seven special working groups under the BRICS industrial channel, and affirmed the efforts of the smart manufacturing and robotics working group in areas such as smart factory development, solution sharing, standards cooperation, and talent training. Recognized that artificial intelligence provides enormous opportunities for promoting economic growth and achieving sustainable development. Pointed out that using artificial intelligence to promote economic growth and social well-being is crucial for advancing countries, especially Global South countries, toward a just, fair, equal, and prosperous future. Affirmed the Shanghai World AI Conference and the High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance, and recognized their contributions to strengthening international AI cooperation and AI for good. (Xinhua News Agency)
